tldr: 最近一週三大法人維持強力買超，外資單日買超寫下史上前段班，惟指數週五因台積電尾盤拉回失守4.6萬點。
台積電2026年AI營收挑戰1.24兆元、訂單能見度直達2028年，並拚將CoWoS先進封裝產能翻約4倍。
金管會推金融大回饋提22項做法，並放寬保險相關金控月獲利揭露時程，因應IFRS 17與ICS雙接軌。

items.title_zh: 法人連續買超 外資單日買超創史上前段班
items.title_en: Institutions extend record buying streak as foreign funds pile into Taiwan stocks
items.summary_zh: 最近一週三大法人維持強力買方，單日合計買超一度達約908億元，其中外資及陸資單日買超約756.95億元，寫下史上單日大額買超之一，隔日再由三大法人加碼約508億元。法人資金持續進場，成為指數在高檔震盪、週五因台積電尾盤拉回失守4.6萬點時的重要支撐，顯示中長線布局意願未減。
items.summary_en: Institutional investors stayed aggressive buyers through the latest trading week, with the three major institutions net buying roughly NT$90.8 billion on the heaviest session and foreign investors alone adding about NT$75.7 billion — one of the largest single-day foreign inflows on record — before a NT$50.9 billion follow-through. The sustained inflow underpinned the TAIEX even as it slipped back below 46,000 on Friday's late TSMC selloff.

items.title_zh: 神秘買家尾盤砸約40億 台積電急拉收2415元
items.title_en: Late-session buyer lifts TSMC as index reclaims key levels during the week
items.summary_zh: 盤中一筆約40億元的尾盤大單將台積電拉升至2,415元，帶動加權指數單日大漲397點、盤中重返45,500點之上，惟隨後獲利了結壓抑漲勢。台積電身為權值王，股價波動持續主導大盤方向，分析師認為在AI題材推動下評價重估仍有延續空間，後市須留意權值股輪動與量能變化。
items.summary_en: A large last-minute order — reportedly around NT$4 billion — pulled TSMC up to NT$2,415 in one session, helping the TAIEX climb 397 points to reclaim the 45,500 level intraday before profit-taking capped gains later in the week. The heavyweight's swings continued to set the tone for the benchmark, with analysts arguing the AI-driven rerating still has room to run.

items.title_zh: 台積電AI營收挑戰兆元 訂單能見度直達2028年
items.title_en: TSMC AI revenue seen heading toward the trillion-NT-dollar mark with visibility to 2028
items.summary_zh: 法人估台積電2026年AI相關營收可望突破400億美元、站上約新台幣1.24兆元，續創新高，訂單能見度已延伸至2028年。6月合併營收4,426.8億元、年增67.9%，上半年累計2.404兆元、年增35.6%。隨AI需求由運算晶片擴及先進封裝，台積電在全球晶圓代工的領導地位持續鞏固，並帶動台灣半導體供應鏈同步受惠。
items.summary_en: Analysts expect TSMC's AI-related revenue to top US$40 billion and clear the NT$1.24 trillion level in 2026, extending its record run as order visibility now stretches to 2028. June revenue reached NT$442.68 billion (+67.9% YoY) and first-half revenue totalled NT$2.404 trillion (+35.6%), reinforcing the foundry's leadership as demand broadens from compute chips into advanced packaging.

items.title_zh: 台積電CoWoS產能拚翻4倍 輝達預訂逾6成
items.title_en: TSMC races to quadruple CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity as Nvidia locks in the bulk
items.summary_zh: 台積電積極擴大CoWoS先進封裝產能，目標由2024年底每月約3.5萬片提升至2026年底每月12萬至14萬片，增幅約4倍，據報導輝達已預訂逾6成產能。經營層表示未觀察到客戶行為出現重大改變，仍持續接收強勁需求訊號，顯示2026年AI相關產能供給依舊吃緊，先進封裝將是全年半導體供應鏈的關鍵瓶頸與成長引擎。
items.summary_en: TSMC is aggressively expanding CoWoS advanced-packaging output, targeting growth from about 35,000 wafers per month in late 2024 toward 120,000–140,000 by end-2026 — a roughly fourfold increase — with Nvidia reported to have booked more than 60% of that capacity. Management says it sees no material change in customer behaviour and continues to receive strong demand signals, underscoring tight AI supply through 2026.

items.title_zh: 金管會推金融大回饋 提22項參考做法鼓勵長期規劃
items.title_en: FSC rolls out a 22-item "financial giveback" guideline to encourage long-term customer benefits
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布金融大回饋指引，採業者自發參與原則，針對社會、客戶與員工三大面向提出22項參考項目，例如銀行業可提供費用回饋、保險業可提供友善理賠等。金管會鼓勵業者將金融大回饋納入公司治理與長期規劃，期望在兼顧股東權益下擴大對客戶與社會的回饋，形塑金融業正向循環與永續經營形象。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission issued a voluntary "financial giveback" guideline built on industry self-participation, listing 22 reference measures across three dimensions — society, customers and employees. Banks can offer fee rebates while insurers can provide friendlier claims handling, with the commission encouraging firms to fold such initiatives into their corporate-governance frameworks and long-term planning.

items.title_zh: 11家有保險業務金控 獲准月獲利公布延至15日
items.title_en: Insurance-linked financial holdcos gain leeway to delay monthly earnings disclosure
items.summary_zh: 因應2026年IFRS 17與ICS雙接軌，金管會同意12家壽險、11家產險與1家再保險共24家保險業，以及11家有保險業務的金控，可將每月獲利公布時程延後至每月15日。此舉讓保險比重較高的金融集團在新會計與資本制度下有更充裕時間彙編財報，兼顧揭露品質與作業負荷，降低轉換期的資訊落差與市場疑慮。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the 2026 IFRS 17 and ICS "dual convergence", 24 insurers — 12 life, 11 non-life and one reinsurer — together with 11 insurance-holding financial-holding companies may push back monthly profit disclosure to the 15th of each month. The relaxation gives insurance-heavy groups more time to compile results under the new accounting and capital regime without compressing reporting quality.

items.title_zh: 超高資產客群成長領先 境外配置幾成標配
items.title_en: Taiwan's ultra-wealthy grow faster than overall personal wealth, with offshore allocation now standard
items.summary_zh: 中國信託與BCG發布的台灣超高資產客群洞察指出，2025至2029年該客群財富年複合成長率約10%，明顯高於整體個人財富成長。進入十億超高資產層級後，境外資產配置幾乎成為標準配備，約86%客戶已持有海外資產，逾半數海外配置達兩成以上，帶動私人銀行、家族信託與跨境財富解決方案需求，成為銀行財管業務兵家必爭之地。
items.summary_en: A CTBC–BCG study on Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth segment projects roughly 10% annual compound growth in this group's wealth over 2025–2029, outpacing overall personal-wealth expansion. At the billion-dollar tier, offshore allocation has effectively become standard: about 86% already hold overseas assets and more than half place at least 20% of their wealth abroad, driving demand for private-banking and cross-border solutions.

items.title_zh: 財管戰場擴大 保險業獲准家數增添生力軍
items.title_en: Regulators and banks widen the wealth-management field as Taiwan courts an asset-management hub
items.summary_zh: 在打造亞洲資產管理中心的政策推動下，主管機關持續深化高資產銀行業務制度，放寬銀行為資產達新台幣1億元以上客戶提供多元商品與諮詢的條件。截至2026年5月，已有10家保險業獲金管會核准辦理財富管理業務，與匯豐、星展、渣打三家外商及六家本土銀行同場競逐高資產客群，市場競爭與商品多元化程度同步升溫。
items.summary_en: Under the push to build an Asian asset-management centre, authorities continue to expand the high-asset banking regime that lets banks serve clients with NT$100 million or more via a broader product and advisory shelf. As of May 2026, 10 insurers had won approval to run wealth-management business, joining three foreign banks (HSBC, DBS, Standard Chartered) and six domestic players competing for high-net-worth mandates.
